sources: Flare 2.0 新动作清单 2026-11-20（Google 表 1njBhCNMs-iliNbt3gKxDwCZnpQBxQoi-yPFRGQHmJwk，P0 伪俄挺俯卧撑）

purpose.zh: 练肩前侧、前锯肌和直臂前倾力量，托马斯移重的高级辅助
purpose.en: Builds front-shoulder, serratus and lean strength for the advanced weight shifts in Thomas flairs.

text.zh: 先往前倾，肩在手前面再往下放
text.en: Lean first, shoulders in front of your hands, then lower

text.zh: 手放在腰两侧，指尖朝外，手腕不舒服就再往外转一点。
text.en: Hands by your waist, fingertips turned out; turn them out more if your wrists complain.

text.zh: 屈肘时手肘贴着身体往后，推起时把地推开。
text.en: Elbows go straight back along your body; push the floor away as you press up.

text.zh: 脚尖踩住垫子，从头到脚跟一条线，别塌腰也别撅屁股。
text.en: Toes planted, head to heels in one line; no sagging, no piking.

commonErrors.zh: 只下放不前倾，肩回到手的正上方
commonErrors.en: Lowering without the lean, shoulders back over the hands.
Flaring your elbows out to the sides.

cautions.zh: 手腕承重很大，先活动手腕；疼就停或减小前倾
cautions.en: Heavy load on the wrists: warm them up; stop or lean less if they hurt.

training.source: flare2 r1 animation tempo (4 s per rep: 1.5 s down, 0.3 s bottom, 1.2 s up)

flare2.plans: 5 个计划（前锯肌/肱三头肌/胸大肌高级；阶段 10/14 高级）
flare2.camera: 正侧面（看清肩超过手掌多少）
flare2.doseBrief: 表内未给剂量；草稿按 3 组 × 6 次、休 90 秒
flare2.note: Animation (r1): shoulders 18 cm past the wrists at the top, 26 cm at the bottom (elbows 88 deg), wrists at 0.56-0.59 of the shoulder->hip line (lower ribs / waist), fingers turned out ~100 deg, feet roll over the toes.

reminders.en: Keep your shoulders in front of your hands

reminders.zh: 手肘贴身体，身体一条线
reminders.en: Elbows in, body in one line
